I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in the DM to confirm. The draft hasn't been sent; someone still needs to review and send it.

- **What it says:** the subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101-per-seat rate, says Marcus Lindqvist supplied it and that Anselm approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis not to pass it on without sign-off from Anselm or June Osei-Lark.
- **Why no extra approval:** a per-seat rate is a finance figure, so Hollis needs approval from Anselm or June to receive it. Anselm is the CFO and gave that approval in this DM. The address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway's sign-off for outside mail doesn't apply.
- **Not checked:** I took the $2,101 figure from Anselm's message and didn't check it against Marcus's original. That isn't in anything Anselm can see.
